title: Agreeing to Disagree: Annotating Offensive Language Datasets with Annotators' Disagreement
reasoning: The paper's core research revolves around the subjectivity and disagreement in annotating offensive language, which is an inherently ethical and moral judgment task. It investigates how different viewpoints impact dataset creation and model performance, advocating for the inclusion of ambiguous cases to better represent diverse perspectives. This moves beyond a simple 'Ethics Statement' to make the study of these moral judgments a central theme of the work.
